issues.description: Stock.findStockIngredient is specified in the UML as findStockIngredient(String), and the solution implements/uses this 1-parameter method. However, the template defines findStockIngredient(String, boolean caseSensitive) and has no 1-parameter overload. As a result, code written according to the specification (e.g., stock.findStockIngredient(name) in SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery/calculateTotalPrice) will not compile against the template without changing the signature or adding an overload.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template match the spec by adding an overload `public StockIngredient findStockIngredient(String name)` that delegates to the existing two-parameter method with a clearly defined default (e.g., `return findStockIngredient(name, true)`), or replace the two-parameter method with the single-parameter version and adjust any internal calls accordingly.
